newsitem.title: SPAIN: ETA claims responsibility for Blanco killing.
newsitem.headline: ETA claims responsibility for Blanco killing.

text.p: Basque separatist rebel group ETA claimed responsibility on Wednesday for the killing of a young Spanish politician that sparked national outrage.
In a statement in its mouthpiece newspaper Egin, ETA said it killed Miguel Angel Blanco and "assumes...and will assume the consequences of the conflict...as crude and painful as they may be."
Egin said the ETA statement was unusually addressed to the Spanish public and written in Castillian Spanish rather than in the Basque language.
The rebels kidnapped Blanco on July 10 and threatened to kill him two days later if the government did not meet its demands to move ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) prisoners to the Basque region.
Millions of Spaniards took to the streets in angry protest when ETA carried out its threat.
The guerrillas said Spain had "created collective hysteria" aimed at criminalising the Basque separatist movement.
